deviations.what: Each round resolves main's current head sha (runner command git_head: GitHub's commits/{branch} with Accept application/vnd.github.sha, public agentculture repos) instead of round one pinning it for the issue (spec decision 'Repo context is pinned per issue').
deviations.reason: Operator approved 2026-11-13 (AskUserQuestion 'Approve d8 (per round)'). Pinning needs a stored sha read back generically: references have no list index, no builtin splits text, and a stored pin would rely on the agent or a new runner script. The repo is read-only context, so a newer main mid-conversation only refreshes what the agent reads.

deviations.what: The repo comes from two Jira fields the operator created, Repository Organization (customfield_10175) and Repository Name (customfield_10174), read by field id, instead of one 'Repo' field; runner commands repo_url and git_head take {org} and {repo} segments instead of a hard-coded agentculture. The bridge's repo_allowlist_prefixes still admits https://github.com/agentculture/ only, so another org fails the round with a comment.
deviations.reason: The operator created the two fields in SCRUM's project settings; a field id survives a rename and needs no /field name lookup, and the reference path can't hold a name with a space.

deviations.what: The agent's final message follows the bridge's result contract: {"summary": "<the round object {comment, decisions, export} as a JSON string>", "threads_addressed": []}; the workflow's json.parse reads agent.summary as before. The comment is capped at 6000 characters (bridge MAX_SUMMARY_CHARS is 8000), the agent step binds the issue key, and the instruction no longer tells the agent to run jira-devague check (not in its allowed tools; it reads the check field of jira-devague agent's output).
deviations.reason: Live probe 2026-11-14: the bridge keeps only the trailing object's summary, so {comment, decisions, export} came back with an empty summary and every round would have failed at parse; jira-devague check was refused (requires approval); the key was not bound. A real round-one run with the fixed instruction returned a summary that passes the parse shape.
